changelog:
Backlink Prospector Lite 1.0.0

- Initial release of the free version.
- Helps users find up to 5 guest post opportunities in their niche.
- Generates a personalized outreach email draft for one target.
- Includes qualification criteria to avoid low-quality sites.
- Preview of full features available in the paid version.
summary: Free version — find guest post opportunities and draft one outreach email. Covers opportunity discovery and basic pitching.
